purpose: Source-located recognition, execution and restraint obligations for the completed remaining Klinkenborg text review; structural/retrieval checks do not establish semantic performance.

recognition.query: A scene uses stock mood labels while its supplied objects already distinguish it. A revision assigns an invented symbolic meaning or psychological state to an observed detail.
criteria: Retrieve the candidate mechanism with its complete exceptions; do not treat a retrieval hit as proof it applies.
Distinguish the application task from the counterexample and its authorized mode.

execution.draft: Inventory: a folded timetable under an empty chair. Draft: The room was filled with the crushing weight of abandonment.
execution.instruction: Compare two defensible responses while preserving the stated record and authorized mode.
execution.reference_response: A folded timetable lay under the empty chair.
alternative_responses: Under the empty chair lay a folded timetable.
criteria: Retain the folded timetable, its location, and the empty chair.
Add no cause, sensation or emotional conclusion.
Name a reader-facing reason for the choice rather than applying a source prescription automatically.

non_application.draft: She wrote in her diary that the empty chair felt like abandonment.
criteria: The interpretation is attributed and supplied. Removing it would erase the writer's reported experience.

recognition.query: A writer calls a specifically identified object a thing, device or substance. An editor proposes technical diction or an etymological correction without evidence.
criteria: Retrieve the candidate mechanism with its complete exceptions; do not treat a retrieval hit as proof it applies.
Distinguish the application task from the counterexample and its authorized mode.

execution.draft: Record: the part is a retaining ring. Draft: The technician removed the small round thing that held the assembly together.
execution.instruction: Compare two defensible responses while preserving the stated record and authorized mode.
execution.reference_response: The technician removed the retaining ring.
alternative_responses: The technician removed the ring that held the assembly together.
criteria: The technician removed the part.
Do not invent dimensions, materials or tool use.
Name a reader-facing reason for the choice rather than applying a source prescription automatically.

non_application.draft: The technician removed an unidentified ring-shaped part.
criteria: The record does not establish that it is a retaining ring. A more technical name would add an unsupported fact.

recognition.query: Several sentences have a mechanically repeated opening or an obscured final emphasis. The writer reports a line sounding awkward but cannot identify the mechanism.
criteria: Retrieve the candidate mechanism with its complete exceptions; do not treat a retrieval hit as proof it applies.
Distinguish the application task from the counterexample and its authorized mode.

execution.draft: We checked the seal. We checked the latch. We checked the hinge. Nothing explained the leak.
execution.instruction: Compare two defensible responses while preserving the stated record and authorized mode.
execution.reference_response: We checked the seal, the latch, the hinge. Nothing explained the leak.
alternative_responses: Seal, latch, hinge: we checked all three. Nothing explained the leak.
criteria: All three parts were checked.
No explanation for the leak was found.
Name a reader-facing reason for the choice rather than applying a source prescription automatically.

non_application.draft: Again we counted. Again we waited. Again we heard nothing.
criteria: The repeated opening carries recurrence and frustration; replacing it merely to create variety can weaken the passage.

recognition.query: A familiar update sounds impersonal, ceremonial or unlike anything the speaker could say. A generic tone request hides uncertainty about who is speaking to whom.
criteria: Retrieve the candidate mechanism with its complete exceptions; do not treat a retrieval hit as proof it applies.
Distinguish the application task from the counterexample and its authorized mode.

execution.draft: The occurrence of a delay in my response was attributable to the necessity of checking the figures.
execution.instruction: Compare two defensible responses while preserving the stated record and authorized mode.
execution.reference_response: I replied late because I needed to check the figures.
alternative_responses: My reply was delayed while I checked the figures.
criteria: The reply was late.
Checking the figures caused the delay.
Name a reader-facing reason for the choice rather than applying a source prescription automatically.

non_application.draft: Please retain this exact clause in the signed notice: 'The response period is extended until Friday.'
criteria: The authorized legal wording and proofreading boundary outweigh an informal-reader experiment.

recognition.query: The draft follows an outline that no longer fits its strongest supported material. The writer keeps shuffling the same words although the underlying relation remains unclear.
criteria: Retrieve the candidate mechanism with its complete exceptions; do not treat a retrieval hit as proof it applies.
Distinguish the application task from the counterexample and its authorized mode.

execution.draft: Outline: celebrate speed. Record: delivery was faster; three checks were missed. Draft: The new system delivered faster. Three checks were missed. Overall, the change was a triumph.
execution.instruction: Compare two defensible responses while preserving the stated record and authorized mode.
execution.reference_response: The new system delivered faster, but three checks were missed. Its speed needs to be weighed against that loss.
alternative_responses: Three checks were missed under the new system, even though it delivered faster.
criteria: Delivery was faster.
Three checks were missed.
No unsupported final evaluation of the system.
Name a reader-facing reason for the choice rather than applying a source prescription automatically.

non_application.draft: Proofread only: 'The new system delivered faster. Three checks were missed.'
criteria: The sentences contain no supplied mechanical error. Structural discovery is outside proofreading authority.

recognition.query: An introduction clears its throat or advertises significance without entering the actual material. A clever first sentence sets up a promise the supplied body cannot answer.
criteria: Retrieve the candidate mechanism with its complete exceptions; do not treat a retrieval hit as proof it applies.
Distinguish the application task from the counterexample and its authorized mode.

execution.draft: Record: the archive closes Friday; two boxes remain uncatalogued. Draft: Archives have always played a vital role in preserving history.
execution.instruction: Compare two defensible responses while preserving the stated record and authorized mode.
execution.reference_response: The archive closes Friday. Two boxes remain uncatalogued.
alternative_responses: Two boxes remain uncatalogued, and the archive closes Friday.
criteria: Closing is Friday.
Two boxes remain uncatalogued.
Name a reader-facing reason for the choice rather than applying a source prescription automatically.

non_application.draft: Emergency notice: 'Leave the building now. Use the east exit.'
criteria: Direct instruction performs the job; a delayed or evocative narrative opening would obstruct it.

recognition.query: A factual narrative includes access to a person's private thoughts or sensory details not established in the notes. An editor relocates facts or excerpts from an interview and risks changing their support or sequence.
criteria: Retrieve the candidate mechanism with its complete exceptions; do not treat a retrieval hit as proof it applies.
Distinguish the application task from the counterexample and its authorized mode.

execution.draft: Record: a station log records arrival at six; a later interview says she was worried. Draft: At six she stepped onto the platform, hearing the bells and fearing dismissal.
execution.instruction: Compare two defensible responses while preserving the stated record and authorized mode.
execution.reference_response: The station log records her arrival at six. In a later interview, she said she had been worried.
alternative_responses: She later said she had been worried. The station log records her arrival at six.
criteria: Arrival was recorded at six.
Worry is a later attributed recollection.
No invented sensation, motive or quotation.
Name a reader-facing reason for the choice rather than applying a source prescription automatically.

non_application.draft: In this fictional scene, invent what the traveler hears on arrival.
criteria: Sensory invention is explicitly authorized here; it must remain within the fictional brief rather than be labeled factual reportage.

recognition.query: The draft reproduces whole chunks of interview or research in collection order. The writer treats chronological narration as compulsory or uses a transition to imply an unsupported inference.
criteria: Retrieve the candidate mechanism with its complete exceptions; do not treat a retrieval hit as proof it applies.
Distinguish the application task from the counterexample and its authorized mode.

execution.draft: Record: hatch opened at nine; alarm sounded at nine ten. Draft: At nine the hatch opened. At nine ten the alarm sounded.
execution.instruction: Compare two defensible responses while preserving the stated record and authorized mode.
execution.reference_response: The alarm sounded at nine ten, ten minutes after the hatch opened.
alternative_responses: The hatch opened at nine. Ten minutes later, the alarm sounded.
criteria: Hatch opening occurred at nine.
Alarm occurred at nine ten.
No causal link is established.
Name a reader-facing reason for the choice rather than applying a source prescription automatically.

non_application.draft: Procedure: 'Open the valve. Wait ten minutes. Read the gauge.'
criteria: Chronological order is functional and required for correct execution; rearrangement for freshness would damage the instructions.
